article.title: Palestinians in Masafer Yatta are surviving without water after Israeli settlers cut off a lifeline
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: In Masafer Yatta in the southern occupied West Bank, Israeli settlers are accelerating their attacks on Palestinian farmers and herders in the area by cutting off their water supply.
